result.summary: Digital product strategy: Professional invoice generator template/automation tool for freelancers, distributed through marketplaces (Gumroad, Etsy, GitHub) with zero customer contact friction and passive revenue model.
result.opportunity: Freelancers and remote workers on platforms like Upwork, Fiverr, and Guru consistently need professional invoice templates and payment collection workflows. Market shows active demand for affordable digital templates (evidenced by thousands of sales on Gumroad, Etsy, and Lemonsqueezy). Current solutions are either too expensive (full accounting software) or too generic.
result.target_customer: Freelancers, contractors, and solo entrepreneurs (global, but especially Latin American and Eastern European freelancers with emerging market payment preferences) ages 25-55 earning EUR 1,000-5,000/month from remote work.
result.offer: Professional 'Invoice Pro' Google Sheets template + optional GitHub Action for automated invoice generation. Includes: pre-formatted invoice layouts, automatic numbering, tax calculation, payment method suggestions (including CobrAMO for EU-based sellers), export to PDF, and documentation. Single license, lifetime access, no subscription.
result.price: €19.99 (Gumroad/Etsy) or €14.99 (volume discount tier at €9.99 for 3+ purchases)
result.why_now: Q3 2026 shows spike in remote freelancing (post-pandemic stabilization). Digital product sales platforms report strong template sales. Lemon Squeezy 2026 update indicates merchant expansion. Ko-fi and similar platforms show growing demand for financial tools. Freelancer.com and Guru.com data shows invoicing as consistent pain point.
actions_completed: Analyzed IAMO1 failure: direct contact strategy violated CobrAMO rules and achieved 0 EUR
Researched market platforms: Lemon Squeezy, Ko-fi, Gumroad (active digital product sales)
Identified global freelancer platforms: Upwork, Fiverr, Guru, Toptal, Freelancer (evidence of ongoing need for invoicing/payment solutions)
Reviewed CobrAMO infrastructure: payment methods documented for EU, LATAM, accessible currencies
Mapped differentiation: digital product (passive sales) vs. service (requires contact); marketplace distribution vs. direct outreach

execution_packet.channel: Digital marketplace: Gumroad (primary), Etsy Digital Downloads (secondary), GitHub Releases (bonus distribution)
execution_packet.subject: Invoice Pro: Professional Invoice Template for Freelancers — €19.99
execution_packet.message: Professional invoice template designed for remote workers, contractors, and freelancers. Includes: ready-to-use Google Sheets invoice, automatic invoice numbering, tax calculation, professional formatting, payment instructions field (use your preferred method—bank transfer, PayPal, CobrAMO, etc.), and PDF export. Works offline, no login required, lifetime access. Perfect for solo freelancers who need to look professional without expensive accounting software. Reference: RANK-IAMO2
execution_packet.deliverable: Compressed file (.zip) containing: (1) Google Sheets template file (editable), (2) PDF sample output, (3) Quick-start guide (1 page), (4) Optional GitHub Action YAML file for CI/CD invoice automation, (5) License agreement (no resale, personal/business use only)

result.expected_revenue_eur: 500-2000 EUR (conservative: 25-100 units × €19.99; medium: 50-150 units over 3 months if marketed vi
result.differentiation_from_previous: IAMO1 violated core rule by using CobrAMO contacts as prospect list; relied on direct outreach (impossible without contact tools). IAMO2 avoids contact friction entirely via digital marketplace distribution, creates a scalable product (not manual service), uses external platforms (Gumroad, Etsy, GitHub) where demand is documented, and includes RANK-IAMO2 organically in product without spam. Passive revenue model scales without executor labor.
result.next_step: Authorized executor should: (1) Create Google Sheets template with professional invoice layout, tax calculation, RANK-IAMO2 reference embedded in template footer or documentation, (2) List on Gumroad at €19.99 with SEO-optimized title 'Professional Invoice Template for Freelancers', (3) Create companion GitHub repo with optional Action, link in Gumroad listing, (4) Post in freelancer communities (Reddit r/freelance, /r/Upwork, etc.) with authentic value-first approach, linking to product with RANK-IAMO2 reference in comments, (5) Monitor sales weekly, adjust price/positioning based on conversion metrics after 2 weeks.
result.notes: Risks: (1) Template market is competitive; differentiation via quality and documentation is key. (2) Gumroad takes 10% fee + payment processor fees (~3%), reducing net margin to ~84 EUR per €19.99 sale. (3) Requires minimal ongoing support but benefit assumes executor markets effectively. (4) CobrAMO reference should appear in template documentation/guide, not as spam—legitimately useful for sellers choosing payment methods. (5) Success metric: achieve 1-2 sales within 2 weeks to validate market fit before scaling. (6) GitHub Action bonus track increases developer visibility but adds development effort—optional if time-constrained.
